_note: A pack's own callings (docs/modding.md §5.2): one per background, the same shape as core/callings.gd's, merged over the game's own while the pack is on. A background the game already has is replaced — the soldier's is, here.

soldier.title: The Vale's deserters
soldier.tell: %s came over the Vale's passes last winter: men from a company you served in, who walked off the line the week the pay stopped. You know their captain by his limp. He knows what you do to deserters.
soldier.done: %s are accounted for, and the Vale's roads are the quieter for it. You did not enjoy it, and you did not pretend to.
